    21	\subsection{Global bounds and the unmasked spectral bottom}
    22	
    23	\begin{lemma}[Gaussian envelope for the original covariance]
    24	  \label{L:variational-heat-envelope}
    25	  For the normalized heat kernel $p_\epsilon(x) =
    26	  (2\pi\epsilon)^{-d/2}e^{-|x|^2/(2\epsilon)}$,
    27	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-heat-envelope}
    28	    (\Gamma*p_\epsilon)(x)
    29	    =\int e^{i\xi\cdot x}e^{-\epsilon|\xi|^2/2}\mu(\ud\xi),
    30	    \qquad
    31	    0\le(\Gamma*p_\epsilon)(x)
    32	    \le(\Gamma*p_\epsilon)(0)<\infty.
    33	  \end{equation}
    34	  The value at zero is strictly positive.
    35	\end{lemma}
    36	
    37	\begin{proof}
    38	  A positive tempered Radon measure has polynomial ball growth. Indeed, evaluate
    39	  its tempered bound on a nonnegative smooth cutoff equal to one on $B_1$,
    40	  dilated by $R \ge 1$. Its finitely many Schwartz seminorms are bounded by
    41	  $CR^N$, so positivity gives a ball-mass bound $CR^N$. Summing dyadic annuli
    42	  shows that $(1+|x|)^{-L}$ is integrable for $L > N$. Apply this separately to
    43	  $\Gamma$ and $\mu$. Gaussian weights are therefore integrable against both
    44	  measures. The classical convolution on the left is finite and smooth locally
    45	  in $x$: on compact $x$ sets its translated Gaussian derivatives are bounded by
    46	  any fixed sufficiently fast polynomial weight in the integration variable.
    47	
    48	  Pair the convolution with a Schwartz test $\varphi$. Absolute Fubini is
    49	  justified by these weights. The resulting pairing is that of $\Gamma$ with
    50	  $p_\epsilon*\varphi$. Applying the spectral convention in
    51	  Hypothesis~\ref{H:homog} and the identity $\int p_\epsilon(y)e^{-i\xi\cdot
    52	  y}\ud y = e^{-\epsilon|\xi|^2/2}$ gives exactly the right side
    53	  of~\eqref{E:variational-heat-envelope} as a distribution. The heat kernel is
    54	  even, so either Fourier sign gives that same Gaussian multiplier. Its spectral
    55	  integral is absolutely finite and continuous in $x$ by dominated convergence.
    56	  Thus, equality of the two continuous distributions gives equality at every
    57	  $x$, without an extra normalization factor. The physical convolution is
    58	  nonnegative. Evenness of $\mu$ makes the spectral integral real, and its
    59	  absolute value is bounded by its total Gaussian mass, the value at zero.
    60	  Finally, $\Gamma \ne 0$ and $p_\epsilon > 0$ give strict positivity there.
    61	  This proves Lemma~\ref{L:variational-heat-envelope}.
    62	\end{proof}

    64	\begin{lemma}[Global regularity of the original mean]
    65	  \label{L:variational-global-mean}
    66	  Every mixed time and space derivative of $h_s$ is globally bounded in space,
    67	  uniformly on compact time intervals. In particular, for $I = [0,1]$ there are
    68	  finite constants $M,C_\Psi$ such that
    69	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-global-mean}
    70	    0\le h_s(x)\le M,\qquad
    71	    \|h_s-h_t\|_\infty\le C_\Psi|s-t|,
    72	    \qquad s,t\in I.
    73	  \end{equation}
    74	\end{lemma}
    75	
    76	\begin{proof}
    77	  Extend $\Psi$ by zero in time; its compact support inside $(0,1)$ makes this a
    78	  smooth extension. For any mixed derivative $D\Psi$, a fixed $\epsilon > 0$ and
    79	  compactness of its common spatial support give $|D\Psi(t,x)| \le
    80	  C_Dp_\epsilon(x)$ for all $t,x$. Here the heat kernel has a positive minimum
    81	  on that support. Lemma~\ref{L:variational-heat-envelope} consequently bounds
    82	  $\Gamma*|D\Psi(t,\cdot)|$ uniformly in $t,x$. Ordinary local differentiation
    83	  against the Radon measure gives the corresponding derivatives of the
    84	  convolution. After the change $r = s-t$,
    85	  \[
    86	    h_s(x)=\int_\R |r|^{-a}
    87	    (\Gamma*\Psi(s-r,\cdot))(x)\ud r.
    88	  \]
    89	  For $s$ in a compact interval the relevant $r$ lie in a fixed bounded
    90	  interval. The preceding global bound times $|r|^{-a}$ is integrable since $a <
    91	  1$. Every derivative thus falls on the smooth test and passes through the
    92	  integral by dominated convergence, with the claimed global spatial bounds.
    93	  Nonnegativity follows from positive kernels. The bounded time derivative
    94	  proves the Lipschitz estimate. No directional decay of the mean has been
    95	  inferred. This proves Lemma~\ref{L:variational-global-mean}.
    96	\end{proof}

    98	\begin{proposition}[The unmasked Rayleigh rate]
    99	  \label{P:variational-unmasked-rate}
   100	  On complex $L^2(\R^d)$, the operator $H_s = -\Delta-h_s$ is self-adjoint on
   101	  $H^2$, with form domain $H^1$ and form $q_s(f) = \|\nabla f\|_2^2-\int
   102	  h_s|f|^2$. Its spectral bottom $E_s$ is uniformly negative on $I$. The
   103	  positive rate $\lambda_{\Psi,s} = \sqrt{-E_s}$ satisfies
   104	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-real-rayleigh}
   105	    \lambda_{\Psi,s}^2
   106	    =\sup_{\substack{f\in H^1(\R^d;\R)\\\|f\|_2=1}}
   107	    \left(\int h_sf^2-\|\nabla f\|_2^2\right).
   108	  \end{equation}
   109	  It is Lipschitz on $I$, and $I_\Psi: = \int_0^1\lambda_{\Psi,s}\ud s$ is
   110	  positive and finite. No eigenstate at the unmasked bottom is asserted.
   111	\end{proposition}
   112	
   113	\begin{proof}
   114	  The Fourier Laplacian $A = -\Delta$ is self-adjoint on $H^2$, being
   115	  multiplication by $|\xi|^2$ with its maximal domain. Multiplication $B_s =
   116	  -h_s$ is bounded self-adjoint with norm at most $M$. Thus, $H_s = A+B_s$ is
   117	  densely defined, symmetric and closed on $H^2$; the two graph norms are
   118	  equivalent under a bounded perturbation. For real $b > M$,
   119	  \[
   120	    H_s-ib=(I+B_s(A-ib)^{-1})(A-ib).
   121	  \]
   122	  The first factor has a Neumann inverse because $\|B_s(A-ib)^{-1}\| \le M/b <
   123	  1$, and the same holds with $+ib$. To check self-adjointness directly, for $u
   124	  \in D(H_s^*)$ solve $(H_s-ib)v = (H_s^*-ib)u$ with $v \in D(H_s)$. Then $u-v
   125	  \in \ker(H_s^*-ib) = \operatorname{Ran}(H_s+ib)^\perp = \{0\}$. Hence,
   126	  $D(H_s^*) = D(H_s)$.
   127	
   128	  Set $c_{\mathrm{shift}} = 1+M$ and $J_s = H_s+c_{\mathrm{shift}} \ge 1$.
   129	  Integration by parts on $H^2$ gives
   130	  \[
   131	    \|J_s^{1/2}f\|_2^2=q_s(f)+c_{\mathrm{shift}}\|f\|_2^2,\qquad
   132	    \|f\|_{H^1}^2\le\|J_s^{1/2}f\|_2^2
   133	    \le c_{\mathrm{shift}}\|f\|_{H^1}^2.
   134	  \]
   135	  Spectral cutoffs $1_{[1,n]}(J_s)$ show that $H^2 = D(J_s)$ is a core for the
   136	  half-power norm; Fourier cutoffs give its density in $H^1$. Completion in the
   137	  equivalent norms identifies $D(J_s^{1/2})$ and $H^1$ as $L^2$ subspaces, since
   138	  both norms dominate $L^2$. This proves the stated form domain.
   139	
   140	  The spectral lower bound gives one direction of the Rayleigh identity. For the
   141	  reverse, nonzero spectral projections in $[E_s,E_s+\epsilon]$ give unit $H^2$
   142	  vectors with Rayleigh values at most $E_s+\epsilon$. The bottom is finite
   143	  because the operator is bounded below and has finite Rayleigh tests. Let
   144	  $\epsilon\downarrow0$. Real tests give the same infimum: $q_s(u+iv) =
   145	  q_s(u)+q_s(v)$, so the quotient is the norm-weighted average of the nonzero
   146	  real quotients. This proves the Rayleigh identity with $-E_s$ on the left. The
   147	  following negative upper bound justifies writing that value as
   148	  $\lambda_{\Psi,s}^2$ in~\eqref{E:variational-real-rayleigh}.
   149	
   150	  Proposition~\ref{P:compact-original-common-trial} supplies, for this original
   151	  $\Psi$, one unit compactly supported $w$ and a finite plateau mask with a
   152	  common strictly negative upper bound $\epsilon_0 > 0$. Its trial has support
   153	  in $B_{2L}$; choose its plateau radius $R_0 \ge 2L$. The unmasked form on this
   154	  same $w$ is no larger. Consequently, $-M \le E_s \le -\epsilon_0 < 0$, and
   155	  $\sqrt{\epsilon_0} \le \lambda_{\Psi,s} \le \sqrt M$. Comparing identical unit
   156	  form tests gives $|E_s-E_t| \le \|h_s-h_t\|_\infty$ and therefore
   157	  \[
   158	    |\lambda_{\Psi,s}-\lambda_{\Psi,t}|
   159	    \le \frac{C_\Psi}{2\sqrt{\epsilon_0}}|s-t|.
   160	  \]
   161	  This also proves positivity and finiteness of $I_\Psi$. No compact-potential
   162	  spectral theorem was applied to $H_s$. This proves
   163	  Proposition~\ref{P:variational-unmasked-rate}.
   164	\end{proof}

   166	\subsection{Removing masks from the numerical lower rate}
   167	
   168	\begin{proposition}[Monotone rates and the original point moment]
   169	  \label{P:variational-remove-mask}
   170	  There is an increasing family of admissible radial masks $m_R$ tending to one,
   171	  for which the compact ground rates satisfy
   172	  $\lambda_{R,s}\uparrow\lambda_{\Psi,s}$ uniformly on $I$ as $R \to \infty$,
   173	  with the compact ground statements used for $R \ge R_0(\Psi)$. For the
   174	  original canonical solution and any fixed $x$,
   175	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-unmasked-point-lower}

176	    \liminf_{T\to\infty}T^{-\kappa}\log\E|u(T,x)|^2
   177	    \ge2I_\Psi-\frac{v_\Psi}{2}.
   178	  \end{equation}
   179	\end{proposition}
   180	
   181	\begin{proof}
   182	  Put $F(t) = e^{-1/t}$ for $t > 0$ and zero otherwise, and define
   183	  \[
   184	    \chi(r)=\frac{F(2-r)}{F(2-r)+F(r-1)},\qquad
   185	    m_R(x)=\chi(|x|/R).
   186	  \]
   187	  The denominator is positive. The numerator decreases and the second
   188	  denominator term increases; thus $\chi$ is nonincreasing, equals one on $r \le
   189	  1$, and zero on $r \ge 2$. Flatness of $F$ at zero gives smoothness. Since
   190	  $\chi$ is constant near zero, $m_R$ is smooth also at the spatial origin.
   191	  These even $[0,1]$ masks increase pointwise to one.
   192	
   193	  Choose $R_0$ so the preceding common trial lies in the plateau. Every $R \ge
   194	  R_0$ has the same negative margin. For each fixed $R$, the compact-family
   195	  theorem applies to $m_Rh_s$. Its real Rayleigh formula follows from the same
   196	  real/complex quotient argument as~\eqref{E:variational-real-rayleigh}. The
   197	  rates are continuous, positive, at most $\sqrt M$ and monotone in $R$. For
   198	  every fixed real unit $f \in H^1$, dominated convergence gives $\int m_Rh_sf^2
   199	  \to \int h_sf^2$. Hence,
   200	  \[
   201	    \sup_{R\ge R_0}\lambda_{R,s}^2
   202	    =\sup_{\|f\|_2=1,\ f\in H^1(\R^d;\R)}
   203	    \sup_{R\ge R_0}
   204	    \left(\int m_Rh_sf^2-\|\nabla f\|_2^2\right)
   205	    =\lambda_{\Psi,s}^2.
   206	  \]
   207	  Only two numerical suprema were interchanged. Positive square roots give the
   208	  pointwise rate convergence. For $R_n = R_0+n$ and $\epsilon > 0$, the
   209	  increasing open sets $\{s:\lambda_{\Psi,s}-\lambda_{R_n,s}<\epsilon\}$ cover
   210	  compact $I$. A finite subcover lies in the largest one, proving uniform
   211	  convergence. Monotonicity extends it to all real $R \to \infty$. Therefore,
   212	  $\int_I\lambda_{R,s}\ud s\uparrow I_\Psi$.
   213	
   214	  At each fixed $R$ use this very same mask in the operator path and mean when
   215	  applying Proposition~\ref{P:raw-block-original-lower}. It gives the lower
   216	  bound with $2\int_I\lambda_{R,s}\ud s-v_\Psi/2$ for the same original point
   217	  liminf. Taking the numerical supremum over these individual bounds proves
   218	  \eqref{E:variational-unmasked-point-lower}. There is no $R(T)$, unmasked noisy
   219	  wave, uniform-in-mask Gaussian estimate or exchange of source and time limits.
   220	  This proves Proposition~\ref{P:variational-remove-mask}.
   221	\end{proof}

   223	\subsection{Full-class dilation and finite variational values for nonnegative controls}
   224	
   225	\begin{lemma}[Radon and Rayleigh dilation]\label{L:variational-control-dilation}
   226	  For $r > 0$ the map
   227	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-control-dilation}
   228	    (D_r\Psi)(s,x)=r^{d+2-\alpha}\Psi(s,rx)
   229	  \end{equation}
   230	  is a bijection of $\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{pos}}$, with inverse $D_{1/r}$. With
   231	  the same original covariance,
   232	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-dilation-values}
   233	    h_{D_r\Psi,s}(x)=r^2h_{\Psi,s}(rx),\qquad
   234	    v_{D_r\Psi}=r^{4-\alpha}v_\Psi,\qquad
   235	    \lambda_{D_r\Psi,s}=r\lambda_{\Psi,s},\quad
   236	    I_{D_r\Psi}=rI_\Psi.
   237	  \end{equation}
   238	\end{lemma}
   239	
   240	\begin{proof}
   241	  Positive dilation preserves the full smooth positive nonzero class;
   242	  multiplication of its amplitude powers gives the stated inverse. Homogeneity
   243	  of the physical Radon measure gives, for every nonnegative measurable $G$,
   244	  \[
   245	    \int G(ry)\Gamma(\ud y)
   246	    =r^{\alpha-d}\int G(z)\Gamma(\ud z).
   247	  \]
   248	  Indeed, its left pushforward measure on a Borel set $A$ is $\Gamma(A/r) =
   249	  r^{\alpha-d}\Gamma(A)$. Positive Tonelli applies this identity inside the
   250	  temporal convolution, giving $h_{D_r\Psi,s}(x) = r^2h_{\Psi,s}(rx)$. Now use
   251	  the \emph{Lebesgue} substitution $z = rx$ in the original pairing:
   252	  \[
   253	    v_{D_r\Psi}=r^{d+2-\alpha}r^2r^{-d}v_\Psi
   254	    =r^{4-\alpha}v_\Psi.
   255	  \]
   256	  This distinguishes the Radon pushforward from the spatial volume factor; it
   257	  includes singular covariances and white noise.
   258	
   259	  The map $U_rf(x) = r^{d/2}f(rx)$ is a unitary bijection on real $L^2$,
   260	  preserving $H^1,H^2$ as sets under its inverse. Weak derivatives give
   261	  $\|\nabla U_rf\|_2^2 = r^2\|\nabla f\|_2^2$ and $\int h_{D_r\Psi,s}(U_rf)^2 =
   262	  r^2\int h_{\Psi,s}f^2$. The real Rayleigh bijection proves the squared rate
   263	  identity; the rates are positive, so their square roots and integrals give
   264	  \eqref{E:variational-dilation-values}. On $H^2$ this is also $H_{D_r\Psi,s}U_r
   265	  = r^2U_rH_{\Psi,s}$. Time has not been rescaled. For compact masks the
   266	  corresponding identity uses $m_R(rx) = m_{R/r}(x)$; a fixed mask radius is not
   267	  invariant. This proves Lemma~\ref{L:variational-control-dilation}.
   268	\end{proof}

   270	\begin{proposition}[Intrinsic variational lower bounds]
   271	  \label{P:variational-positive-scores}
   272	  For $c > 0$, the set of variational values
   273	  $\{cI_\Psi-v_\Psi/2:\Psi\in\mathcal{C}_{\mathrm{pos}}\}$ is nonempty and
   274	  bounded above. Its finite real supremum $S_c^{\mathrm{pos}}$ is positive and
   275	  satisfies
   276	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-score-homogeneity}
   277	    S_c^{\mathrm{pos}}=c^{(4-\alpha)/(3-\alpha)}S_1^{\mathrm{pos}},
   278	    \qquad
   279	    Q_2\ge S_2^{\mathrm{pos}},
   280	  \end{equation}
   281	  where $Q_2$ is the original point liminf. The coefficient-one value is an
   282	  auxiliary variational value; no first-moment or source-constant identification
   283	  is asserted.
   284	\end{proposition}
   285	
   286	\begin{proof}
   287	  Write $k = 3-\alpha > 0$, $q = 4-\alpha = k+1$ and $m = q/k > 1$. Fix one
   288	  $\Psi_0$ from the nonempty class and put $I_0 = I_{\Psi_0} > 0$, $v_0 =
   289	  v_{\Psi_0} > 0$. Positivity of the latter is
   290	  Lemma~\ref{L:compact-raw-profile}. For $r_0 = (I_0/v_0)^{1/k} > 0$, which need
   291	  not be less than one, the exact real-power identity gives
   292	  \[
   293	    I_{D_{r_0}\Psi_0}-v_{D_{r_0}\Psi_0}/2
   294	    =r_0I_0-r_0^qv_0/2=r_0I_0/2>0.
   295	  \]
   296	  This positive value is obtained from a smooth nonnegative control.
   297	
   298	  For $c > 0$ put $r_c = c^{1/k}$ and $K_c = c^m > 0$.
   299	  Lemma~\ref{L:variational-control-dilation} and the exact scalar powers give,
   300	  for every $\Psi$,
   301	  \begin{equation}\label{E:variational-score-set-scaling}
   302	    cI_{D_{r_c}\Psi}-v_{D_{r_c}\Psi}/2
   303	    =K_c(I_\Psi-v_\Psi/2).
   304	  \end{equation}
   305	  Since $D_{r_c}$ is a bijection of the entire class, the whole set of
   306	  variational values with coefficient $c$ is $K_c$ times the whole
   307	  coefficient-one set of variational values.
   308	
   309	  We prove boundedness before taking finite-real suprema. The independent
   310	  Theorem~\ref{T:full-upper}, for the \emph{same canonical solution}, gives
   311	  \[
   312	    \E|u(T,0)|^2\le e(T+2)^d e^{C_{\mathrm{up}}T^\kappa},
   313	    \qquad T\ge1,\quad C_{\mathrm{up}}<\infty.
   314	  \]
   315	  Its prefactor is negligible: choose $\epsilon = \kappa/2 > 0$, use $\log T \le
   316	  (T^\epsilon-1)/\epsilon$ and $\log(T+2) \le \log T+\log3$ for $T \ge 1$, and
   317	  divide by $T^\kappa$. Thus, the original point limsup is at most
   318	  $C_{\mathrm{up}}$. One fixed test/mask lower bound gives a finite lower bound
   319	  for $Q_2$, so $Q_2$ is finite. By~\eqref{E:variational-unmasked-point-lower}
   320	  every coefficient-two variational expression is at most this same $Q_2 \le
   321	  C_{\mathrm{up}}$, uniformly in $\Psi$.
   322	  Equation~\eqref{E:variational-score-set-scaling} at $c = 2$ consequently
   323	  bounds all coefficient-one variational values by $C_{\mathrm{up}}/K_2$. The
   324	  nonempty set has a finite real supremum $S_1^{\mathrm{pos}} > 0$ by the
   325	  positive test above.
   326	
   327	  For general $c$, set equality and $K_c > 0$ show that $K_cS_1^{\mathrm{pos}}$
   328	  is the supremum: it is an upper bound, and every smaller number is exceeded by
   329	  $K_c$ times a coefficient-one variational expression within the corresponding
   330	  positive distance of its supremum. This proves finiteness, positivity and the
   331	  first identity in~\eqref{E:variational-score-homogeneity}. Taking the
   332	  numerical supremum of the coefficient-two lower bounds proves the second.
   333	  Although $2^m > 2$, the resulting $S_2^{\mathrm{pos}} > 2S_1^{\mathrm{pos}}$
   334	  is only a comparison of auxiliary variational values. It is not a Jensen
   335	  improvement without a first-moment identification. This proves
   336	  Proposition~\ref{P:variational-positive-scores}.
   337	\end{proof}

   339	For $\Gamma = 0$, the mean, original variance and Rayleigh rate are zero. Set
   340	all these variational values to zero; the free canonical solution $u = 1$ has
   341	the corresponding zero moment rate. Strict positivity above is restricted to
   342	nonzero covariance. Matching an upper variational rate and identifying an exact
   343	pointwise limit remain later steps.

    15	public import Mathlib
    16	public import StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.KappaRange

    18	
    19	@[expose] public section

    25	open MeasureTheory

    27	
    28	namespace StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.HomogHypothesis
    29	
    30	/-- Euclidean space `ℝ^d`. -/
    31	abbrev Rd (d : ℕ) := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
    32	
    33	/-- A tempered measure: `∫ (1 + ‖x‖)^(-k) dν < ∞` for some natural `k`. -/
    34	def IsTempered {d : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Rd d)) : Prop :=
    35	  ∃ k : ℕ, ∫⁻ x, ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + ‖x‖) ^ (-(k : ℝ))) ∂ν < ⊤
    36	
    37	/-- An even measure: invariant under `x ↦ -x`. -/
    38	def IsEven {d : ℕ} (ν : Measure (Rd d)) : Prop :=
    39	  ν.map (fun x => -x) = ν
    40	
    41	/-- Positive-definiteness of `Γ` as a tempered distribution:
    42	`⟨Γ, φ ⋆ φ̃⟩` is a nonnegative real for every Schwartz `φ`, where
    43	`(φ ⋆ φ̃)(x) = ∫ φ(x + y) conj(φ(y)) dy` and `φ̃(x) = conj(φ(-x))`. -/
    44	def IsPosDefDistr {d : ℕ} (Γ : Measure (Rd d)) : Prop :=
    45	  ∀ φ : SchwartzMap (Rd d) ℂ,
    46	    (∫ x, (∫ y, φ (x + y) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ y)) ∂Γ).im = 0 ∧
    47	      0 ≤ (∫ x, (∫ y, φ (x + y) * (starRingEnd ℂ) (φ y)) ∂Γ).re
    48	
    49	/-- `μ` is the spectral measure of `Γ` in the manuscript's convention
    50	`Γ = ∫ e^{i ξ·x} μ(dξ)` in the sense of tempered distributions:
    51	`∫ φ dΓ = ∫ (∫ φ(x) e^{i ξ·x} dx) μ(dξ)` for every Schwartz `φ`. -/
    52	def IsSpectralMeasure {d : ℕ} (Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)) : Prop :=
    53	  ∀ φ : SchwartzMap (Rd d) ℂ,
    54	    ∫ x, φ x ∂Γ =
    55	      ∫ ξ, (∫ x, φ x * Complex.exp (Complex.I * (inner ℝ ξ x : ℝ))) ∂μ
    56	
    57	/-- Hypothesis `H:homog`. Let `d ∈ {1,2,3}` and `0 < α₀ < 1`. The spatial
    58	covariance is a nonnegative, even, positive-definite tempered Radon measure
    59	`Γ` on `ℝ^d` with positive even tempered Radon spectral measure `μ`,
    60	`Γ = ∫ e^{i ξ·x} μ(dξ)`; for every Borel set `A` and `c > 0`,
    61	`Γ(cA) = c^{d-α} Γ(A)`; `α₀ + α < 2` (`E:threshold`), with `0 < α < d` or
    62	`α = d = 1`. A Lean measure is nonnegative, and on `ℝ^d` a locally finite
    63	Borel measure is a Radon measure. -/
    64	structure HomogCovariance (d : ℕ) (alpha alpha0 : ℝ) (Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)) :
    65	    Prop where
    66	  dim : d = 1 ∨ d = 2 ∨ d = 3
    67	  alpha0_pos : 0 < alpha0
    68	  alpha0_lt_one : alpha0 < 1
    69	  Γ_radon : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure Γ
    70	  Γ_even : IsEven Γ
    71	  Γ_tempered : IsTempered Γ
    72	  Γ_posdef : IsPosDefDistr Γ
    73	  μ_radon : IsLocallyFiniteMeasure μ
    74	  μ_even : IsEven μ
    75	  μ_tempered : IsTempered μ
    76	  spectral : IsSpectralMeasure Γ μ
    77	  scaling : ∀ A : Set (Rd d), MeasurableSet A → ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c →
    78	    Γ (c • A) = ENNReal.ofReal (c ^ ((d : ℝ) - alpha)) * Γ A
    79	  threshold : alpha0 + alpha < 2
    80	  alpha_range : (0 < alpha ∧ alpha < d) ∨ (alpha = d ∧ d = 1)
    81	
    82	/-- The numerical part of `H:homog`, in the form used by `DriverParameters`
    83	(with `a = α₀`). -/
    84	theorem homog_params {d : ℕ} {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    85	    (h : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) :
    86	    DriverParameters.Homog d alpha alpha0 :=
    87	  ⟨h.dim, h.alpha0_pos, h.alpha0_lt_one, by linarith [h.threshold], h.alpha_range⟩
    88	
    89	/-- `E:kappa` with the manuscript's hypothesis: under `H:homog`,
    90	`κ = (4 - α - α₀)/(3 - α) ∈ (1, 2)`. -/
    91	theorem kappa_mem_Ioo_paper {d : ℕ} {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
    92	    (h : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) :
    93	    KappaRange.kappa alpha alpha0 ∈ Set.Ioo 1 2 :=
    94	  KappaRange.kappa_mem_Ioo d alpha alpha0 h.dim h.alpha0_pos h.alpha0_lt_one
    95	    h.threshold h.alpha_range
    96	
    97	/-- `E:driver-parameters` with the manuscript's hypothesis (the section
    98	retains `H:homog` and sets `a = α₀`): its strict intervals are nonempty. -/
    99	theorem parameters_nonempty_paper {d : ℕ} {alpha alpha0 : ℝ} {Γ μ : Measure (Rd d)}
   100	    (h : HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Γ μ) :
   101	    ∃ γ θ β : ℝ, (0 < γ ∧ γ < min (1 / 2) ((2 - alpha) / 2)) ∧
   102	      (1 / 2 < θ ∧ θ < β ∧ β < min (1 - alpha0 / 2) ((3 - alpha0 - alpha) / 2)) :=
   103	  DriverParameters.parameters_nonempty d alpha alpha0 (homog_params h)
   104	
   105	end StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.HomogHypothesis

5762	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-cd
  5763	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.cd
  5764	  kind: definition
  5765	  summary: "cd d = (2 pi)^(-d/2) (real rpow): the constant c_d of the section's unitary Fourier transform."
  5766	  keywords: [fourier-convention, normalization]
  5767	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5768	  status: reusable
  5769	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-cd-pos
  5770	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.cd_pos
  5771	  kind: theorem
  5772	  summary: "For every natural d: 0 < cd d."
  5773	  keywords: [fourier-convention, positivity]
  5774	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5775	  status: internal
  5776	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-cd-sq-mul
  5777	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.cd_sq_mul
  5778	  kind: theorem
  5779	  summary: "For every natural d: cd d ^ 2 * (2 pi)^d = 1."
  5780	  keywords: [fourier-convention, normalization]
  5781	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5782	  status: internal
  5783	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-paper-hat
  5784	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.paperHat
  5785	  kind: definition
  5786	  summary: "For f : R^d -> E (E a complex normed space) and xi: paperHat f xi = (cd d : C) • (Bochner integral over Lebesgue measure of x -> exp(-(I * <xi, x>)) • f x)."
  5787	  keywords: [fourier-transform, unitary-convention]
  5788	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5789	  status: reusable
  5790	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-paper-hat-eq-fourier
  5791	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.paperHat_eq_fourier
  5792	  kind: theorem
  5793	  summary: "For f : R^d -> E (E a complex normed space) and xi: paperHat f xi = (cd d : C) • 𝓕 f ((2 pi)^-1 • xi), where 𝓕 is Mathlib's Fourier transform with kernel exp(-2 pi i <v, w>)."
  5794	  keywords: [fourier-transform, unitary-convention]
  5795	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5796	  status: reusable
  5797	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-integrable-paper-hat-integrand
  5798	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.integrable_paperHat_integrand
  5799	  kind: theorem
  5800	  summary: "For a Schwartz map f : R^d -> E (E a complex normed space) and xi: x -> exp(-(I * <xi, x>)) • f x is Lebesgue-integrable."
  5801	  keywords: [fourier-transform, schwartz-map]
  5802	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5803	  status: reusable
  5804	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-dil-apply
  5805	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.dil_apply
  5806	  kind: theorem
  5807	  summary: "For real c != 0 and x in R^d: dil c hc x = c • x."
  5808	  keywords: [dilation, linear-equiv]
  5809	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5810	  status: internal
  5811	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-hat-s-apply
  5812	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.hatS_apply
  5813	  kind: theorem
  5814	  summary: "For a Schwartz map f : R^d -> E (E a complex normed space) and xi: hatS f xi = paperHat f xi (so paperHat f is the Schwartz map hatS f)."
  5815	  keywords: [fourier-transform, schwartz-map]
  5816	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5817	  status: internal
  5818	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-continuous-paper-hat
  5819	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.continuous_paperHat
  5820	  kind: theorem
  5821	  summary: "For a Schwartz map f : R^d -> E (E a complex normed space): paperHat f is continuous."
  5822	  keywords: [fourier-transform, schwartz-map]
  5823	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5824	  status: reusable
  5825	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-integrable-paper-hat
  5826	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.integrable_paperHat
  5827	  kind: theorem
  5828	  summary: "For a Schwartz map f : R^d -> E (E a complex normed space): paperHat f is Lebesgue-integrable."
  5829	  keywords: [fourier-transform, schwartz-map]
  5830	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5831	  status: reusable
  5832	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-paper-inversion
  5833	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.paper_inversion
  5834	  kind: theorem
  5835	  summary: "For E a complex Banach space, a Schwartz map f : R^d -> E and x: f x = (cd d : C) • integral of eta -> exp(I * <eta, x>) • paperHat f eta over Lebesgue measure."
  5836	  keywords: [fourier-inversion, unitary-convention]
  5837	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5838	  status: reusable
  5839	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-integrable-one-add-pow-mul
  5840	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.integrable_one_add_pow_mul
  5841	  kind: theorem
  5842	  summary: "For a Schwartz map f : R^d -> E (E a real normed space) and natural N: u -> (1 + norm u)^N * norm(f u) is Lebesgue-integrable."
  5843	  keywords: [schwartz-map, polynomial-weight]
  5844	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5845	  status: reusable
  5846	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-zc-apply
  5847	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.zc_apply
  5848	  kind: theorem
  5849	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta and x: zc zeta x = (zeta x : C)."
  5850	  keywords: [schwartz-map, complexification]
  5851	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5852	  status: internal
  5853	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-zeta-r
  5854	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.zetaR
  5855	  kind: definition
  5856	  summary: "zetaR zeta R x = zeta(R^-1 • x) for a real Schwartz map zeta and any real R: the mask zeta_R(x) = zeta(x/R) (real-valued)."
  5857	  keywords: [mask, dilation]
  5858	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5859	  status: reusable
  5860	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-k-r
  5861	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.kR
  5862	  kind: definition
  5863	  summary: "kR zeta R = paperHat (x -> (zetaR zeta R x : C)): the kernel k_R, the section's transform of the mask."
  5864	  keywords: [mask-kernel, fourier-transform]
  5865	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5866	  status: reusable
  5867	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-lz
  5868	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.Lz
  5869	  kind: definition
  5870	  summary: "Lz zeta = Bochner integral over Lebesgue measure of eta -> norm(paperHat (x -> (zeta x : C)) eta): the constant L = norm(zeta-hat)_1."
  5871	  keywords: [mask-kernel, l1-norm]
  5872	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5873	  status: reusable
  5874	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-zeta-s-apply
  5875	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.zetaS_apply
  5876	  kind: theorem
  5877	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta, R != 0 and x: zetaS zeta R hR x = (zetaR zeta R x : C)."
  5878	  keywords: [mask, schwartz-map]
  5879	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5880	  status: internal
  5881	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-k-r-eq-hat-s
  5882	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.kR_eq_hatS
  5883	  kind: theorem
  5884	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta and R != 0: kR zeta R = hatS (zetaS zeta R hR) as functions."
  5885	  keywords: [mask-kernel, schwartz-map]
  5886	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5887	  status: internal
  5888	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-continuous-k-r
  5889	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.continuous_kR
  5890	  kind: theorem
  5891	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta and R != 0: kR zeta R is continuous."
  5892	  keywords: [mask-kernel, continuity]
  5893	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5894	  status: reusable
  5895	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-integrable-k-r
  5896	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.integrable_kR
  5897	  kind: theorem
  5898	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta and R != 0: kR zeta R is Lebesgue-integrable."
  5899	  keywords: [mask-kernel, integrability]
  5900	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5901	  status: reusable
  5902	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-k-r-scale
  5903	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.kR_scale
  5904	  kind: theorem
  5905	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta, R > 0 and u in R^d: kR zeta R u = (R^d : C) * paperHat (x -> (zeta x : C)) (R • u)."
  5906	  keywords: [mask-kernel, dilation]
  5907	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5908	  status: reusable
  5909	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-integral-norm-k-r
  5910	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.integral_norm_kR
  5911	  kind: theorem
  5912	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta and R > 0: integral over Lebesgue measure of u -> norm(kR zeta R u) equals Lz zeta."
  5913	  keywords: [mask-kernel, l1-norm]
  5914	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5915	  status: reusable
  5916	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-eq-zero-of-paper-hat-eq-zero
  5917	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.eq_zero_of_paperHat_eq_zero
  5918	  kind: theorem
  5919	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta with paperHat (x -> (zeta x : C)) eta = 0 for every eta: zeta = 0."
  5920	  keywords: [fourier-injectivity, schwartz-map]
  5921	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5922	  status: reusable
  5923	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-lz-pos
  5924	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.Lz_pos
  5925	  kind: theorem
  5926	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta != 0: paperHat (x -> (zeta x : C)) is Lebesgue-integrable and 0 < Lz zeta."
  5927	  keywords: [mask-kernel, positivity]
  5928	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5929	  status: reusable
  5930	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-k-r-neg
  5931	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.kR_neg
  5932	  kind: theorem
  5933	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta, any real R and u: kR zeta R (-u) = conj (kR zeta R u)."
  5934	  keywords: [mask-kernel, conjugation]
  5935	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5936	  status: reusable
  5937	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-norm-k-r-neg
  5938	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.norm_kR_neg
  5939	  kind: theorem
  5940	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta, any real R and u: norm(kR zeta R (-u)) = norm(kR zeta R u)."
  5941	  keywords: [mask-kernel, conjugation]
  5942	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean

  5944	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-rho
  5945	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.rho
  5946	  kind: definition
  5947	  summary: "rho mu zeta R eta = ENNReal.ofReal(cd d^2 * Lz zeta) * (lower integral over mu(dxi) of enorm(kR zeta R (xi - eta))): the density rho_R, valued in [0, inf]."
  5948	  keywords: [auxiliary-measure, density]
  5949	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5950	  status: reusable
  5951	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-nu
  5952	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.nu
  5953	  kind: definition
  5954	  summary: "nu mu zeta R = volume.withDensity (rho mu zeta R): the measure nu_R(d eta) = rho_R(eta) d eta."
  5955	  keywords: [auxiliary-measure, with-density]
  5956	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5957	  status: reusable
  5958	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-measurable-k-r-sub
  5959	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.measurable_kR_sub
  5960	  kind: theorem
  5961	  summary: "For a real Schwartz map zeta and R != 0: (xi, eta) -> enorm(kR zeta R (xi - eta)) is measurable on R^d x R^d."
  5962	  keywords: [mask-kernel, measurability]
  5963	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5964	  status: internal
  5965	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-measurable-rho
  5966	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.measurable_rho
  5967	  kind: theorem
  5968	  summary: "For mu s-finite and R != 0: rho mu zeta R is measurable."
  5969	  keywords: [auxiliary-measure, measurability]
  5970	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5971	  status: internal
  5972	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-lintegral-nu
  5973	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lintegral_nu
  5974	  kind: theorem
  5975	  summary: "For mu s-finite, R != 0 and measurable w : R^d -> [0, inf]: lintegral of w d(nu mu zeta R) = ofReal(cd d^2 * Lz zeta) * lintegral over mu(dxi) of lintegral over d eta of w eta * enorm(kR zeta R (xi - eta))."
  5976	  keywords: [auxiliary-measure, tonelli]
  5977	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5978	  status: reusable

  5981	  kind: theorem

  5983	  keywords: [auxiliary-measure, tonelli]
  5984	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5985	  status: reusable
  5986	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-preimage-sub-closed-ball

  5988	  kind: theorem

  5993	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-preimage-sub-ball
  5994	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.preimage_sub_ball
  5995	  kind: theorem
  5996	  summary: "For u, y in R^d and real r: the preimage of ball y r under xi -> xi - u is ball (y + u) r."
  5997	  keywords: [ball, translation]
  5998	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  5999	  status: internal
  6000	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-lintegral-enorm-k-r
  6001	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lintegral_enorm_kR

  6005	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  6006	  status: internal
  6007	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-lz-nonneg

  6009	  kind: theorem

  6011	  keywords: [mask-kernel, nonnegativity]
  6012	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  6013	  status: internal
  6014	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-nu-le-of-translate-le
  6015	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.nu_le_of_translate_le
  6016	  kind: theorem
  6017	  summary: "For mu s-finite, R > 0, measurable A and real M with mu((xi -> xi - u)^-1 A) <= ofReal M for every u: nu mu zeta R A <= ofReal(cd d^2 * Lz zeta^2 * M)."
  6018	  keywords: [auxiliary-measure, ball-mass]
  6019	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean

  6025	  keywords: [spectral-measure, ball-mass]
  6026	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean

  6028	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-nu-closed-ball-le

  6032	  keywords: [auxiliary-measure, ball-mass]
  6033	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/MaskedAuxiliaryNorm.lean
  6034	  status: reusable
  6035	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/masked-auxiliary-norm-nu-ball-le

  6340	  summary: "If SpectralHomogeneous mu alpha and theta > 0, for any real a: N1 a theta mu = theta^(alpha+a-2) * N1 a 1 mu (an identity of Lean integrals; integrability is in DampedNorms.N1_integrable)."

  6342	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean

  6348	  keywords: [damped-norm, green-mass]
  6349	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean

  6355	  keywords: [subordination, fubini]
  6356	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6357	  status: internal
  6358	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-fks-apply
  6359	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.FKS_apply
  6360	  kind: theorem
  6361	  summary: "FKS a theta S (l, y) = (indicator of S applied to l -> FK a theta (l, y)) at l."

  6363	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6364	  status: internal
  6365	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-integral-fks-eq

  6367	  kind: theorem
  6368	  summary: "For measurable S, every xi and (s,t): the integral over (0,inf) in l of FKS a theta S (l,(xi,(s,t))) equals N2onIntegrand a theta S ((s,t),xi)."
  6369	  keywords: [subordination, temporal-kernel]
  6370	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6371	  status: internal

  6373	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.inner_FKS_eq
  6374	  kind: theorem
  6375	  summary: "For s-finite mu with (1+|xi|^2)^(-1) mu-integrable and mu{0} = 0, theta > 0 and l > 0: the integral in xi of the integral over (0,inf)^2 of FKS a theta S (l,(xi,p)) equals 1_S(l) * weight a theta mu l."
  6376	  keywords: [subordination, fubini]
  6377	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6378	  status: internal

  6380	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N2onSq_eq
  6381	  kind: theorem
  6382	  summary: "For s-finite mu with (1+|xi|^2)^(-1) mu-integrable, mu{0} = 0, 0 < a < 1, theta > 0, measurable S: N2onIntegrand is integrable on (0,inf)^2 x R^d, N2onOuter on (0,inf)^2, and N2onSq a theta S mu = int over S of weight."
  6383	  keywords: [damped-norm, laplace-truncation]

  6387	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N2onSq_univ
  6388	  kind: theorem
  6389	  summary: "For a > 0, any theta and mu: N2onSq a theta univ mu = N2sq a theta mu (the unrestricted second norm is N_2(theta)^2)."
  6390	  keywords: [damped-norm, laplace-truncation]
  6391	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6392	  status: reusable
  6393	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-n1on-univ
  6394	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N1on_univ
  6395	  kind: theorem
  6396	  summary: "For any a, theta and mu: N1on a theta univ mu = N1 a theta mu (the unrestricted first norm is N_1(theta))."
  6397	  keywords: [damped-norm, laplace-truncation]
  6398	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6399	  status: reusable
  6400	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-smoothed-s-finite
  6401	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.smoothed_sFinite
  6402	  kind: theorem
  6403	  summary: "Instance: if mu is s-finite, then smoothed mu g is s-finite."
  6404	  keywords: [smoothing, s-finite]
  6405	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6406	  status: internal
  6407	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-integrable-mul-of-le-one
  6408	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.integrable_mul_of_le_one
  6409	  kind: theorem
  6410	  summary: "If g : R^d -> NNReal is measurable with g <= 1 and f is mu-integrable, then xi -> g xi * f xi is mu-integrable."
  6411	  keywords: [smoothing, integrability]
  6412	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean

  6415	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.smoothed_hR
  6416	  kind: theorem
  6417	  summary: "If g is measurable with g <= 1 and (1+|xi|^2)^(-1) is mu-integrable, it is (smoothed mu g)-integrable."
  6418	  keywords: [smoothing, integrability]
  6419	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6420	  status: internal
  6421	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-smoothed-zero
  6422	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.smoothed_zero
  6423	  kind: theorem
  6424	  summary: "If mu{0} = 0 then (smoothed mu g){0} = 0."
  6425	  keywords: [smoothing, null-set]
  6426	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6427	  status: internal
  6428	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-resolvent-smoothed-le
  6429	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.resolvent_smoothed_le
  6430	  kind: theorem

  6432	  keywords: [smoothing, resolvent]
  6433	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6434	  status: reusable
  6435	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-weight-smoothed-le
  6436	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.weight_smoothed_le
  6437	  kind: theorem
  6438	  summary: "If g is measurable with g <= 1, (1+|xi|^2)^(-1) is mu-integrable, a > 0, theta > 0, l > 0: weight a theta (smoothed mu g) l <= weight a theta mu l."
  6439	  keywords: [smoothing, clock-weight]
  6440	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6441	  status: reusable
  6442	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/damped-norms-homog-n2on-sq-smoothed-mono
  6443	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N2onSq_smoothed_mono
  6444	  kind: theorem
  6445	  summary: "For s-finite mu, (1+|xi|^2)^(-1) mu-integrable, mu{0}=0, 0<a<1, theta>0, g measurable with g<=1, measurable S subset S': both N2onOuter integrands integrable on (0,inf)^2 and N2onSq a theta S (smoothed mu g) <= N2onSq a theta S' mu."
  6446	  keywords: [smoothing, laplace-truncation]
  6447	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6448	  status: reusable

  6450	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N1on_smoothed_mono
  6451	  kind: theorem
  6452	  summary: "For s-finite mu, (1+|xi|^2)^(-1) mu-integrable, a>0, theta>0, the N_1 integrand for mu integrable on (0,inf), g measurable with g<=1, S subset S': the N_1 integrand for smoothed mu g is integrable and N1on a theta S (smoothed mu g) <= N1on a theta S' mu."
  6453	  keywords: [smoothing, laplace-truncation]
  6454	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean
  6455	  status: reusable

  6458	  kind: theorem

  6464	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N2tail_props
  6465	  kind: theorem
  6466	  summary: "Under H:homog, for every real M: N2onIntegrand alpha0 1 (Ioi M) is integrable on (0,inf)^2 x R^d, N2onOuter alpha0 1 (Ioi M) mu on (0,inf)^2, N2tailSq alpha0 M mu = int over (M,inf) of weight alpha0 1 mu, and 0 <= N2tailSq alpha0 M mu."
  6467	  keywords: [tail-norm, nonnegativity]

  6471	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N1tail_tendsto
  6472	  kind: theorem
  6473	  summary: "Under H:homog (HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Gamma mu): N1tail alpha0 M mu -> 0 as M -> inf."

  6478	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.N2tail_tendsto
  6479	  kind: theorem
  6480	  summary: "Under H:homog (HomogCovariance d alpha alpha0 Gamma mu): N2tailSq alpha0 M mu -> 0 and N2tail alpha0 M mu -> 0 as M -> inf."
  6481	  keywords: [tail-norm, limit]
  6482	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/DampedNormsHomog.lean

  6485	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.DampedNormsHomog.damped_homogeneous_norms_paper
  6486	  kind: theorem
  6487	  summary: "Under H:homog and GreenMass G: for theta>0 finiteness, N2sq>=0, N_0 integrable with N0 = theta^(-2), N_1 and N_2^2 scaling; for every M tail integrability and N2tailSq>=0; both tails -> 0; smoothing (g<=1) and truncation (S subset S') bounds."

6492	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-k
  6493	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heatK
  6494	  kind: definition
  6495	  summary: "heatK eps x = (2 pi eps)^(-d/2) * exp(-norm(x)^2/(2 eps)) on R^d, for every real eps: the normalized heat kernel p_eps."
  6496	  keywords: [heat-kernel, gaussian-envelope]
  6497	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean

  6499	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-k-pos
  6500	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heatK_pos
  6501	  kind: theorem
  6502	  summary: "If eps > 0 then heatK eps x > 0 for every x."
  6503	  keywords: [heat-kernel, positivity]
  6504	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6505	  status: internal
  6506	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-spec
  6507	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heatSpec
  6508	  kind: definition
  6509	  summary: "heatSpec eps x xi = exp(i <xi,x>) * exp(-eps norm(xi)^2/2) as a complex number: the spectral integrand of E:variational-heat-envelope."
  6510	  keywords: [heat-kernel, spectral-measure]
  6511	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6512	  status: reusable
  6513	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-k-integrable
  6514	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heatK_integrable
  6515	  kind: theorem
  6516	  summary: "If Gamma is tempered (IsTempered) and eps > 0, then for every x the function y -> heatK eps (x - y) is Gamma-integrable."
  6517	  keywords: [heat-kernel, integrability]
  6518	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6519	  status: reusable
  6520	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-spec-integrable
  6521	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heatSpec_integrable
  6522	  kind: theorem
  6523	  summary: "If mu is tempered and eps > 0, then heatSpec eps x is mu-integrable for every x."
  6524	  keywords: [heat-kernel, integrability]
  6525	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6526	  status: internal
  6527	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-identity
  6528	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heat_identity
  6529	  kind: theorem
  6530	  summary: "If IsSpectralMeasure Gamma mu and eps > 0, then for every x, (conv Gamma (heatK eps) x : C) = integral of heatSpec eps x over mu (identity of Lean integrals; no integrability conclusion)."
  6531	  keywords: [heat-kernel, spectral-measure]
  6532	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6533	  status: reusable
  6534	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-envelope
  6535	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heat_envelope
  6536	  kind: theorem
  6537	  summary: "If Gamma, mu are tempered, IsSpectralMeasure Gamma mu and eps > 0: for all x, y -> heatK eps (x-y) is Gamma-integrable, heatSpec eps x is mu-integrable, the identity holds, and 0 <= conv Gamma (heatK eps) x <= conv Gamma (heatK eps) 0."
  6538	  keywords: [heat-kernel, gaussian-envelope]
  6539	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6540	  status: reusable
  6541	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-heat-conv-pos
  6542	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.heat_conv_pos
  6543	  kind: theorem
  6544	  summary: "If Gamma is tempered, Gamma != 0 and eps > 0, then 0 < conv Gamma (heatK eps) 0."
  6545	  keywords: [heat-kernel, positivity]
  6546	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6547	  status: reusable
  6548	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-abs-rpow-integrable-on
  6549	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.abs_rpow_integrableOn
  6550	  kind: theorem
  6551	  summary: "If a < 1, then r -> |r|^(-a) is integrable on Ioo (-1) 1."
  6552	  keywords: [time-kernel, integrability]
  6553	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6554	  status: reusable
  6555	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-abs-rpow-integral
  6556	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.abs_rpow_integral
  6557	  kind: theorem
  6558	  summary: "If a < 1, then the integral of |r|^(-a) over Ioo (-1) 1 equals 2/(1-a)."
  6559	  keywords: [time-kernel, integral-value]
  6560	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6561	  status: reusable
  6562	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-exists-radius
  6563	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.exists_radius
  6564	  kind: theorem
  6565	  summary: "If Psi : R x R^d -> R has compact support, there is R >= 0 with Psi(u,z) = 0 whenever R < norm(z)."
  6566	  keywords: [compact-support, spatial-support]
  6567	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6568	  status: internal
  6569	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-eq-zero-of-time
  6570	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.eq_zero_of_time
  6571	  kind: theorem
  6572	  summary: "If tsupport Psi is contained in Ioo 0 1 x univ and u is not in Ioo 0 1, then Psi(u,z) = 0 for every z."
  6573	  keywords: [control-class, time-support]
  6574	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6575	  status: internal
  6576	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-one-le-gauss
  6577	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.one_le_gauss
  6578	  kind: theorem
  6579	  summary: "If norm(z) <= R, then 1 <= exp(R^2/2) * exp(-norm(z)^2/2)."

  6581	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6582	  status: internal
  6583	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-g-mass
  6584	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.gMass
  6585	  kind: definition
  6586	  summary: "gMass Gamma = integral of exp(-norm(y)^2/2) over Gamma (a Lean Bochner integral; its integrability is in gauss_conv at x = 0)."

  6588	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6589	  status: internal
  6590	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-gauss-conv
  6591	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.gauss_conv
  6592	  kind: theorem
  6593	  summary: "If Gamma, mu are tempered and IsSpectralMeasure Gamma mu, then for every x: y -> exp(-norm(x-y)^2/2) is Gamma-integrable and its integral is <= gMass Gamma."
  6594	  keywords: [gaussian-envelope, covariance-measure]
  6595	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6596	  status: reusable
  6597	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-g-mass-nonneg
  6598	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.gMass_nonneg
  6599	  kind: theorem
  6600	  summary: "For every measure Gamma, 0 <= gMass Gamma."
  6601	  keywords: [gaussian-envelope, positivity]
  6602	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6603	  status: internal
  6604	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-pt-bound

  6606	  kind: theorem
  6607	  summary: "If |Psi p| <= B for all p and Psi(u,z) = 0 whenever R < norm(z), then |Psi(u,z)| <= B * exp(R^2/2) * exp(-norm(z)^2/2) for all u, z."
  6608	  keywords: [gaussian-envelope, pointwise-bound]
  6609	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6610	  status: internal

  6614	  summary: "If |Psi p - Psi q| <= L dist(p,q) and Psi(u,z) = 0 for R < norm(z): |Psi(u,z) - Psi(u',z')| <= L dist((u,z),(u',z')) exp(R^2/2) (exp(-norm(z)^2/2) + exp(-norm(z')^2/2))."
  6615	  keywords: [gaussian-envelope, lipschitz]
  6616	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6617	  status: internal
  6618	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-conv-integrable
  6619	  decl: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.VariationalMean.conv_integrable
  6620	  kind: theorem
  6621	  summary: "If Gamma, mu are tempered, IsSpectralMeasure Gamma mu, Psi is continuous, |Psi| <= B and Psi(u,z) = 0 for R < norm(z): y -> Psi(u, x - y) is Gamma-integrable for all u, x."
  6622	  keywords: [original-mean, integrability]
  6623	  file: StratonovichHAMSecondMoment/VariationalMean.lean
  6624	  status: internal
  6625	- id: stratonovich-ham-second-moment-lean/variational-mean-conv-le

/usr/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import re,collections,json
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('candidate/statement-ledger.md'); lines=p.read_text().splitlines(); rows=[]; bad=[]; module=''
for n,l in enumerate(lines,1):
 if l.startswith('## '): module=l[3:]
 if l.startswith('|') and re.search(r'"'`Stratonovich(?:HAMAudit|HAMSecondMoment)'"\\.',l):
  cells=re.split(r'(?<"'!'"\\\\)\\|',l)[1:-1]
  names=re.findall(r'"'`(Stratonovich(?:HAMAudit|HAMSecondMoment)'"\\.["'^`]+)`'"',cells[1])
  rows.extend((n,module,cells[0].strip(),name) for name in names)
  if len(cells)"'!=4: bad.append((n,len(cells)))
print('"'ROWS',len(rows),'labelled',sum(not r[2].startswith('no direct label') for r in rows),'unlabelled',sum(r[2].startswith('no direct label') for r in rows),'BAD-CELLS',bad)
c=Path('lean/claims.yaml').read_text(); decl=re.findall(r'"'^  decl: (.+)$'"',c,re.M); kinds=collections.Counter(re.findall(r'"'^  kind: (.+)$'"',c,re.M)); rc=collections.Counter(r[3] for r in rows)
print('CLAIMS',len(decl),'KINDS',dict(kinds),'MISSING',set(decl)-rc.keys(),'EXTRA',rc.keys()-set(decl),'NONUNIQUE',[(k,v) for k,v in rc.items() if v"'!=1])
print('"'PER-MODULE',dict(collections.Counter(r[1] for r in rows)))
idx=lines[179:317]
for m in ['TimeCompletion','MaskedContinuousWaveCompleted','MaskedContinuousWave','MaskedAuxiliaryNorm','DampedNormsHomog','VariationalMean','PhaseBessel']:
 table=[r for r in rows if r[3].startswith('StratonovichHAMSecondMoment.'+m+'.')]; ct=collections.Counter(); mism=[]
 for n,l in enumerate(idx,180):
  cells=re.split(r'(?<"'!'"\\\\)\\|',l)
  if len(cells)<4 or 'cross-reference only' in cells[1]:continue
  for r in table:
   name=r[3].split('.',1)[1]
   if '"'`'"'+name+'"'`'"' in cells[2]:
    ct[name]+=1
    lab='no direct label' if r[2].startswith('no direct label') else re.search(r'"'`([''^`]+)`'"',r[2]).group(1)
    if (lab=='no direct label' and not cells[1].strip().startswith(lab)) or (lab"'!='"'no direct label' and '"'`'"'+lab+'"'`'"' not in cells[1]):mism.append((n,name,lab))
 print('INDEX',m,'rows',len(table),'indexed',sum(ct.values()),'missing',[r[3] for r in table if ct[r[3].split('.',1)[1]]"'!=1],'"'mismatched',mism)
PY"

    63	/-- `‖Σ c_j v_j‖² ≤ (Σ |c_j|) Σ |c_j| ‖v_j‖²` for a finite family in a complex
    64	seminormed space (in particular in any complex inner product space). -/
    65	theorem norm_sq_sum_le {ι E : Type*} [SeminormedAddCommGroup E] [NormedSpace ℂ E]
    66	    (s : Finset ι) (c : ι → ℂ) (v : ι → E) :
    67	    ‖∑ j ∈ s, c j • v j‖ ^ 2 ≤
    68	      (∑ j ∈ s, ‖c j‖) * ∑ j ∈ s, ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖ ^ 2 := by
    69	  have htri : ‖∑ j ∈ s, c j • v j‖ ≤ ∑ j ∈ s, ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖ := by
    70	    refine (norm_sum_le _ _).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
    71	    exact Finset.sum_congr rfl fun j _ => norm_smul _ _
    72	  have hcs : (∑ j ∈ s, ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖) ^ 2 ≤
    73	      (∑ j ∈ s, ‖c j‖) * ∑ j ∈ s, ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖ ^ 2 := by
    74	    have key := Finset.sum_mul_sq_le_sq_mul_sq s (fun j => Real.sqrt ‖c j‖)
    75	      (fun j => Real.sqrt ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖)
    76	    have e1 : ∀ j, Real.sqrt ‖c j‖ * (Real.sqrt ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖) = ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖ :=
    77	      fun j => by rw [← mul_assoc, Real.mul_self_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)]
    78	    have e2 : ∀ j, Real.sqrt ‖c j‖ ^ 2 = ‖c j‖ :=
    79	      fun j => Real.sq_sqrt (norm_nonneg _)
    80	    have e3 : ∀ j, (Real.sqrt ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖) ^ 2 = ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖ ^ 2 :=
    81	      fun j => by rw [mul_pow, e2]
    82	    simp only [e1, e2, e3] at key
    83	    exact key
    84	  have h0 : 0 ≤ ‖∑ j ∈ s, c j • v j‖ := norm_nonneg _
    85	  calc ‖∑ j ∈ s, c j • v j‖ ^ 2 ≤ (∑ j ∈ s, ‖c j‖ * ‖v j‖) ^ 2 :=
    86	        pow_le_pow_left₀ h0 htri 2
    87	    _ ≤ _ := hcs
